_note: PLACEHOLDER objectives for the Phase 4 contract system. pay_share + salvage_share is negotiated per contract.

objectives.name: Extract HVT
objectives.description: Recover the HVT hard case and carry it to extraction (two-handed).

objectives.name: Evacuate Survivors
objectives.description: Reach the survivors and escort them to the evac point.

objectives.name: Convoy Escort
objectives.description: Keep the supply truck alive from one zone to the next.

objectives.name: Sabotage Supply Line
objectives.description: Breach the depot and destroy the fuel store.

objectives.name: Salvage Run
objectives.description: Strip a crash site and extract with as much as you can carry.
